uncertainty.method: paired source/duplicate-component cluster percentile bootstrap; exploratory with 11 clusters; no model selection

training_diagnostics.weighting: equal family/translation mass and per-query balanced classes

provenance.offline_verification: macOS sandbox-exec deny network* for training, production evaluation and manual searches

limitations: Candidate replay isolates ranking cost; it is not full search latency.
Known-judgment metrics; unjudged candidates may be relevant.
Agent review only, no independent human review.
Test was previously reported for hybrid and includes a corrected test intent.
Only 34 original positive source components; validation lacks text-heavy sources.
Native Windows/Linux inference and 8 GB hardware were not exercised in this study.
Exploratory cluster intervals use only 11 test components; nDCG delta interval crosses zero.
No feature, coefficient, regularization or label changes were made in response to inspected test performance.
